title: Minimizing Congestion for Balanced Dominators

problem.claim: Metagenomics requires reconstructing individual microbial genomes from mixtures of short sequencing fragments.

gap.claim: The setting presents unresolved challenges in reducing uncertainty and improving scalability.

contributions.claim: The paper considers two problems related to reducing uncertainty and improving scalability in metagenomic assembly-graph analysis.

narrative_sequence.summary: Metagenomics involves reconstructing individual microbial genomes from mixtures of short sequencing fragments.
Recent work uses assembly-graph sparsity to find r-dominating sets for rapid approximate queries through dominator-centric graph partitioning.
The paper considers two problems aimed at reducing uncertainty and improving scalability in this setting.
